title: One-nucleon intermediate-state contribution to the pion-coupled four-quark condensate in the $N$--$J/ψ$ interaction
summary: The density dependence of four-quark condensates is a major source of uncertainty in operator product expansion analyses of hadrons in nuclear matter. Their determination is particularly relevant to the $N$--$J/ψ$ interaction, whose long-range attraction appears to be well described by two-pion exchange in lattice QCD. We evaluate the pion-coupled four-quark condensates using one-nucleon intermediate-state insertions and incorporate them into the QCD sum rule analysis for the $J/ψ$ meson in nuclear matter.
